title: Record the guard's wiring as proven end-to-end by the first real promotion
description: OMARK-58/59/60 each recorded that the suite proves the SCRIPTS LOGIC but not the WORKFLOW WIRING, and the header instructs: do not report it as proven end-to-end before this repositorys first real promotion. That promotion happened at run 35031089133 on 65c3be9. The guard printed: main moved forward 432b95931b8203c347f81c9c0824cca686ac087d -> 65c3be97fd016e93b277a9301c3b1f88f249e697; its HEAD is a commit dev holds (dev tip 65c3be9), and is devs tip exactly, with nothing left behind. The 432b959 matches the promotion pushs own 432b959..65c3be9 output, so BEFORE_SHA carried mains true previous HEAD from github.event.before - which is the one thing no static assertion can show. No shallow diagnosis appeared, so fetch-depth: 0 and the explicit refspec both did their job. A stale unproven note is itself the failure mode this file is about: it makes a later reader re-derive or distrust a measured fact.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The proof suites header no longer says the workflow wiring is unproven, and cites the run that proved it with the verdict line it printed
The claim is bounded to what that run actually measured, naming what a single non-zero-BEFORE_SHA promotion still cannot show

finalSummary: Delivered in PR #123. The header's 'unproven until the first real promotion' note is replaced with what run 35031089133 on 65c3be9 actually printed, including the verdict line, and bounded to it. Proven: BEFORE_SHA arrives from github.event.before carrying main's true previous HEAD (432b959, matching the push's own 432b959..65c3be9), all three assertions spoke, and no shallow diagnosis appeared so fetch-depth: 0 and the explicit refspec worked against a real actions/checkout. NOT proven and said so: FORCED was false throughout, the all-zeros branch-creation path never ran, and no failing branch was exercised against real Actions inputs - a green promotion run is not evidence a red one would be reported correctly.
